items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including a template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, BlockStrap) that could lead to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. It also fixes issues leading to privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE (CVE-2026-103849)
items.summary: A template engine injection flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required, and new installs may remain vulnerable.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce (CVE-2025-54236)
items.summary: A critical flaw allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Although patched in September 2025, mass exploitation was observed starting October 22, 2026, with many stores still vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including several incorrect authorization flaws and stored cross-site scripting issues. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: This update addresses a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, StyleSmuggler) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (CVE-2026-75650) under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day template engine injection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) leading to privilege escalation. Successful exploitation could also result in security feature bypass and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated customer account takeover (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: An unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw that could lead to customer account takeover and privilege escalation. This was addressed as part of the APSB26-92 security update.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 6 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a significant security update for numerous extensions, addressing six critical vulnerabilities. These critical flaws could lead to remote code execution, account takeover, admin login bypass, and payment fraud.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without authentication, potentially leading to remote code execution.
